content.text: According to a planning inspector, the large quantities of hazardous materials stored on the land have posed numerous health risks, and residents have raised concerns about a terrible odor emanating from the site.

Since the 1970s, the site has been functioning and collecting household waste from various parts of East Lancashire; however, it has experienced growth and is currently extending into residential neighborhoods.
